messages:
henry: Dropping the Legal Hold modal copy + badge treatment for review. Fig: https://figma.com/file/legalhold (frame: modal-v2). Want to make sure copy, chip phrasing, audit line, and a11y are tight.

maya: Quick read: modal title "Enable legal hold" ok, but CTA should read "Enable legal hold" (primary) and secondary "Cancel". Add one-line later: "This prevents automatic deletion until removed."

liz: Copy nits: for KMS chip and helper text avoid the lone word "Managed". Use `Redwood-managed (platform)` or `Customer-managed (BYOK)`. Helper subtext: `Key stored in customer's KMS; Redwood does not have key access.`

katie: Accessibility nits: modal close button must be in tab order and have aria-label. The Legal Hold toggle inside the modal must be reachable via keyboard and have aria-pressed or aria-checked depending on control used. When enabled, announce with aria-live: `Legal hold enabled for policy: [policy name]`. Also ensure color contrast for the Legal Hold badge meets AA (red badge currently fails). Consider adding a lock icon inside the badge so color isn't the only cue.

omar: Audit log/schema: include machine fields for all changes. Suggested machine-readable example (paste into infra ticket):
```
2026-10-04T09:15:22Z policy.update actor=liz@example.com policy_id=pol_402 action=legal_hold:enable before=legal_hold=false after=legal_hold=true kms_owner=customer region=eu-west-1 source=console
```

henry: Good. Also include a short human-readable summary for the UI audit view: `Legal hold enabled for "Customer Data Export" by liz@example.com. Retention unaffected; Key: Customer-managed (BYOK).` That makes compliance reviewers happy.

maya: Modal microcopy: confirmation line should read: `Are you sure you want to enable legal hold for this policy? This prevents automatic deletion and must be removed manually.` Add a small `Learn more` link to docs.

liz: Chip phrasing for the compact policy row: `eu-west-1` 30 days7 `Customer-managed (BYOK)`; if region unset show `Region: Unspecified` instead of `Global`. Tooltip for key chip: `Customer-managed (BYOK) 1 key stored in customer's KMS; Redwood has no key access.`

katie: Keyboard/Focus flow: trap focus in modal, initial focus on primary CTA or first interactive control depending on pattern, and after enabling move focus to a status region that is aria-live polite with the summary. Test with NVDA + VoiceOver.

omar: Small CSV/audit export note: ensure exported logs include `kms_owner` and human-friendly `key_description` columns. Avoid the word "Managed" alone in CSV fields.

henry: UI behaviour: when Legal Hold is set show a persistent badge on the policy row and in the policy header; badge should have aria-label `Legal hold: enabled` and be keyboard focusable if it opens a detail flyout.

maya: Mobile: ensure badge + close icon have 44px touch targets. If space is tight, move the edit icon into an overflow menu but keep Legal Hold visible.

liz: I'll draft the copy PR with modal strings, badge text, and tooltips. Proposed strings: Modal primary CTA = `Enable legal hold`, badge = `Legal hold` (with lock icon), key labels = `Redwood-managed (platform)` | `Customer-managed (BYOK)`, helper detail = `Key stored in customer's KMS; Redwood does not have key access.`

katie: I'll run a quick screen reader pass on the new modal tonight and file any a11y bugs.

legal-bot: Added Figma comment by henry: "modal copy updated + badge icon proposal" (automated).

henry: Thanks everyone. Action items: liz=copy PR, katie=a11y pass, omar=infra audit example, maya=contrast + icon options, henry=update Figma with badge lock. Ping here if any copy still implies Redwood has key access. :thumbsup:
